# NetEase protocol adapter

The Dart adapter in lib/features/music_platform/netease ports the documented request formats and encryption contracts of @neteaseapireborn/api 4.29.7, derived from Binaryify/NeteaseCloudMusicApi. The pinned npm source is distributed under the MIT license reproduced alongside this notice. The interface family is also used by https://github.com/qier222/YesPlayMusic .

No YesPlayMusic UI or Node runtime is embedded. This adapter uses direct HTTPS to the upstream music hosts and independent secure storage; it does not require an API deployment.

The full catalogue uses the same pinned 4.29.7 package and MIT request modules. `tool/generate_netease_full_catalog.cjs` produces explicit native Dart request builders; `tool/capture_netease_full_contracts.cjs` independently captures upstream contracts for regression checks. Original module hashes are recorded in `assets/data/netease-full-catalog.json`.

The files in `afp/` are copied from that package's `public/audio_match_demo` (credited upstream to mos9527/ncm-afp). The package MIT license is preserved there. The sole adaptation in `afp.js` replaces the Node logger import with a no-op logger. AFP runs locally in an isolated WebView with no account cookies or API calls; network matching remains in the Dart HTTPS client. Original `afp.wasm.js` SHA-256 and source archive integrity are recorded in the full-catalogue implementation report. The upstream repository link currently returns 404; provenance is the fixed npm distribution, not a claim that the original repository remains accessible.

Version 1.0.12 additionally compares music and podcast contracts used by https://github.com/algerkong/AlgerMusicPlayer at f57204d4205769a4457f5975796a35e41785f1d8. Presentation remains the original Mesting Flutter implementation. The Android fallback resolver is independently implemented in Dart: it tries https://api.bugpk.com/api/163_music by exact NetEase song ID, then strictly matched anonymous public sources. No NetEase account cookies are shared with fallback providers. The original account stream remains preferred; delivered quality and fallback provenance are retained. No UnblockNeteaseMusic Node server or desktop binary is embedded.

Version 1.0.14 implements the private-picture wire format independently in Dart. Public field names and upload/send sequencing were checked against XiaoMengXinX/Music163Api-Go at 9167996e9052ab8a0b3826f0614d5f5f0b092241 (`api/msgSend.go`, `api/nosToken.go`). That GPL-3.0 project's Go source is not copied, linked, bundled or redistributed here; it is a reference for interoperable request data, not an application dependency. The Flutter pages and state ownership are Mesting implementations.

Recent-play logging additionally uses the separate `startplay` and actual-duration `play` wire events described in https://github.com/NeteaseCloudMusicApiEnhanced/api-enhanced/issues/167 and the recent-play fix documented by https://github.com/missuo/kumone . The fixed upstream `clientlog.music.163.com` target and its request-local desktop identity apply only to logging. A received log is not represented as verified cloud history; the app checks the read API separately. Together's nine request contracts remain those of the pinned package and https://github.com/Binaryify/NeteaseCloudMusicApi/issues/1676 . Authenticated interoperability is not established by public protocol references or anonymous probes.

Version 1.0.18 adds platform-specific quality IDs while preserving the four original Kugou IDs. Enhanced NetEase level parameters, sky immerseType and the request-local vivid client identity were checked against https://github.com/neteasecloudmusicapienhanced/api-enhanced/blob/main/module/song_url_v1.js (reviewed 2026-10-29). These are interoperable stream request formats, not an embedded official sound-effect engine. Successful replacement requires the actual returned level; strict enhanced requests cannot be fulfilled by another provider. No upstream Node implementation or additional engine is bundled.
